description: Intent i013 (SNAPSHOT=s12, BRANCH=xmit-softirq-lock) complete. FINDING (medium confidence): drivers/net/wireless/mwl8k.c:1973-2024 — priv->stream_lock (declared mwl8k.c:205, spin_lock_init at 5945) is shared between a softirq-reachable xmit path and process/workqueue paths with plain spin_lock() at every site (1973/2037/2060/2110 in mwl8k_txq_xmit; 3697 in the mwl8k_watchdog_ba_events workqueue worker, INIT_WORK 5923, queued from the hardirq handler at 4480; 4027 in mwl8k_cmd_set_new_stn_del reached from mwl8k_sta_remove 5183; 5296+ in mwl8k_ampdu_action), and zero spin_lock_bh/local_bh_disable on this lock anywhere. Softirq side: mwl8k_tx (ieee80211_ops .tx, mwl8k.c:4551) -> mwl8k_txq_xmit at 4565 takes stream_lock plainly at 1973 while the same function takes the sibling priv->tx_lock with spin_lock_bh at 2045 — proving the xmit path runs with BH enabled. Any QoS data frame for an HT-capable station (mwl8k.c:1969-1971) plus a BA-watchdog interrupt/sta-remove/ampdu config on the same CPU yields a NET_TX softirq spinning forever on stream_lock against a preempted worker/process holder — soft lockup, RCU stall, TX-stall DoS, the exact ks7010 seed shape (commit 058cbee52ccd). Counter-evidence: mwl8k_fw_lock quiesces TX for some holder paths but sta_remove/ampdu_action re-acquire outside the quiesce; the tx_lock sibling shows the driver knows the _bh pattern. SECOND CANDIDATE (recorded, partially traced): hostap hostap_hw.c:1721/2117 plain spin_lock(&local->txfidlock) in prism2_transmit_cb and prism2_alloc_ev ('Called only from hardware IRQ') vs spin_lock_irqsave on the same lock at 1665 in prism2_get_txfid_idx from the xmit path prism2_tx_80211, plus plain baplock at 1864/2231 vs spin_lock_bh at 836/904 — mixed-discipline sharing that may better fit branch 3/4. SAFE: hostap_ap.c sta_table_lock plain sites are all timer/tasklet-side with process sites using _bh; hostap_80211_rx.c:446 plain local->lock is the RX-tasklet side; cw1200 wsm_cmd.lock both sides are cw1200_bh workqueue/process context; ath9k sc_pcu_lock plain site is tasklet-side with all process sites _bh. UNRESOLVED: ath5k txq->lock/txbuflock, zd1211rw zd_usb.c, cassini.c (30 plain sites), staging wlan-ng/rtl*. The literal ks7010 seed is absent from s12 (no drivers/staging/ks7010) and is excluded regardless. Static analysis only: no .config/headers for a build, so the mwl8k finding is a source-level hypothesis expressed at medium confidence. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i013.json.
